eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Morgan, UT; at 9:20 AM on AUG 9, 2026 Effective until 9:20 AM AUG 10, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Morgan County Wildfire 10:15 am: Mandatory evacuation for Whites crossing to East Canyon Dam. Life-threatening, fast-changing conditions. Leave now and avoid the area. Leave immediately by the designated route. Take only what you have already prepared by the door. Do not stop to gather additional belongings. Help neighbors leave if it is safe to do so. Keep listening to local news and cell phone alerts. Shelter is located Morgan High School, Trojan Center 699 E Young St. If you cannot leave, call 911.
